## Overview

Half-Elves exist through natural interbreeding between Elves and Humans. They are one of the two hybrid races of Kythoria (alongside Half-Orcs). They follow standard Fifth Edition traits and lifespan ranges (~200 years).

---

## Origins

Half-Elves are the natural offspring of Elves and Humans. No god claims them directly -- they fall between **Kaelthor** (who claims Elves) and **Aloria** (who claims Humans). This makes them an unclaimed race in the divine deception.

---

## The Claiming God (None)

| God | Domains | Falsely Claims |
|-----|---------|----------------|
| *(None)* | -- | Half-Elves (unclaimed) |

No god claims Half-Elves. They fall between Kaelthor and Aloria -- whether this is deliberate or an oversight is not known. Half-Elves occupy a middle space in the pantheon's narrative.

---

## Society & Culture

Half-Elf culture follows standard Fifth Edition norms. Half-Elves often feel caught between two worlds, but in the unified society of the Last Stand, they are accepted members of the community. Their dual heritage makes them natural diplomats and wanderers.

---

## Racial Traits

Uses standard Fifth Edition Half-Elf traits (darkvision, Fey Ancestry, Skill Versatility, extra language). No setting-specific modifications documented at this time.

---

## Social Standing

Half-Elves face no direct blame related to the divine conspiracy. They are generally accepted across Kythoria, though some devout communities may view their unclaimed status with mild suspicion.

---

## Notable Individuals

- **Odessa Merikh** -- Half-elf rogue of the Venom-Weavers, hunting her biological father Valen Healoris (see `odessa_merikh.md`).
- **Satriya Merikh** -- Half-elf runic mage, Odessa's adoptive mother, killed by Valen's strike team (see `satriya_merikh.md`).
